codeReview.summary: The desktop cleanup was executed thoroughly and correctly. All Electron-specific files were removed, package.json and vite.config.js were cleaned of Electron dependencies and settings, and the README was updated with clear browser-only startup instructions. Browser startup verification confirmed both backend and frontend work independently.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker had to recreate the Python virtual environment because the existing venv was created on Windows and incompatible with Linux (missing Scripts/activation scripts, wrong structure). The library/environment.md should document that venv may need recreation when switching between Windows and Linux/WSL environments.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows: 'The virtual environment was created on Windows. Let me create a new Linux-compatible venv' followed by 'rm -rf venv && python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt'

sharedStateObservations.observation: The services.yaml correctly specifies backend start as 'cd backend && python main.py' but doesn't account for venv activation. On Linux/WSL, the correct command should be 'cd backend && ./venv/bin/python main.py' or activating venv first. This matches what the worker ended up doing.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: services.yaml line 'start: cd backend && python main.py' vs worker's actual command './venv/bin/python main.py'

sharedStateObservations.observation: The architecture.md still contains '(being removed in this mission)' text referring to Electron removal, which is now complete. Should be updated to reflect the new browser-only architecture.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: architecture.md lines 14 and 20: 'Electron wrapper (being removed in this mission).' and 'Local browser-only (no Electron, no cloud).'

VAL-DESKTOP-001.notes: README.md now documents browser-only startup with two terminal workflow (backend on 8000, frontend on 3001). Verified working via curl tests in handoff.

VAL-DESKTOP-002.notes: All Electron dependencies (electron, electron-builder, cross-env) and scripts (electron, electron:dev, electron:build, electron:pack) removed from package.json. No electron process in runtime.

VAL-DESKTOP-003.notes: Handoff verification shows: curl http://localhost:8000/health returned {"status":"ok"}, curl http://localhost:3001 returned HTML with TradeLab title.

VAL-DESKTOP-004.notes: Bootstrap API call curl http://localhost:8000/api/portfolio returned {"portfolio_size":2000.0001245642788}. No Electron-specific assumptions in code.

VAL-DESKTOP-005.notes: All desktop launcher files removed: start-tradelab-desktop-launcher.vbs, start-tradelab-desktop.bat, start-tradelab-desktop.ps1. No stale launcher files remain to cause confusion.

VAL-DESKTOP-006.notes: services.yaml defines backend and frontend as independent services with separate start/stop commands. Browser tab close does not affect backend process. Frontend dev server has no Electron lifecycle hooks.

summary: PASS. The desktop cleanup feature was implemented correctly. All Electron runtime files, installer scripts, and desktop launcher files were removed. The package.json was cleaned of Electron dependencies and scripts. The vite.config.js was updated to remove Electron-specific settings (base: './'). The README was updated with clear browser-only startup instructions. Browser startup verification confirmed both services work independently. No blocking issues found.
